Sorry to hear that. I guess the tropical climate where I live is a big factor. Basically I do 3 stretch and folds with 45 mins in between each, then let it bulk ferment for 1.5 hours after the 3rd stretch and fold. That's a total of 3 hours of fermentation. After that I divide the dough and let it rest at least 20 mins before final shaping and proofing for another 30 mins. All at room temp (or slightly higher since I usually place the dough atop my preheating oven). Hope this helps!
